A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the enterovirus is a common pathogen in the patients with myocardial disease in Yunnan and Shanghai.
the enteroviruses in selenium deficiency area are different with the enterovirues in other areas, especially in the genetic variation at 234(CT) and 690 (AC).

there are 3 coxsackieviral isolates (B3, B5 and B6) from Yunnan province, and 2 coxsackievial isolates from Yunnan and Shanghai (B3 and B6) have different nucleotide sequences in the 5′ noncoding region compared with published coxasackieviruses.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the genetic variation of the 5′ nontranslational region of coxsackieviral isolate is not difference from intertype genetic divergence of the 5’ nontranslational regions of coxsackie virus B, and the variation at 234(C→T) and 690 (A→C) in the 5′ terminal region of B3 may be associated with the geographic location of the isolate and needs further study.
